sheets.prompt: Surface design sheet for a science fiction exploration game, the great shell domes and towers of a far city in a desert: smooth domes of white ceramic, sea-teal and burnt orange, built of large curved panels set in rings that follow the dome's curve, the seams fine and slightly raised, a few panels of a slightly different tone, wind-polished tops, a faint band of sand-scour near the ground, a few small round vents and a thin maintenance ladder. Three panels side by side: a large swatch of the curved panelling; a cluster of these domes and a tower rising from the dunes, seen from far off with a small figure for scale; a strip showing the marks simplifying with distance, panel rings staying, seams and vents gone, flat colour far. Calm, clean, flat colour dominant, marks sparse and fine. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, ceramic white, sea teal, burnt orange and pale sand, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, photo texture, text, watermark, lettering, labels, tiles, bricks.
